pendingIdeas.title: Make the shared comparison route render server HTML before five pages are written on top of it
pendingIdeas.description:
Verified on 22 Oct 2026: /compare, /alternatives and /discord-vs-zedu return HTTP 200 but only 8 visible words in the served HTML, and all three canonicalise to https://zedu.chat. By contrast /solutions/bootcamps returns 422 visible words. A programmatic comparison page built on that template would ship copy no crawler can read and point every variant at the homepage, so the five 'Slack alternative' pages would compete with the homepage instead of ranking.

Approach: (1) find the client boundary in the shared comparison template and move the H1, comparison table, FAQ and internal links into a server component; (2) add generateMetadata per route with a self-referential canonical and a title that includes the audience; (3) assert in the release check that each of the five routes returns more than 300 visible words and a canonical equal to its own URL; (4) record before/after word counts and canonical values in the delivery.

Why it fits: the goal is five programmatic landing pages. The template they share is the actual constraint, and fixing it once makes all five indexable rather than only the copy correct.

Done when: each of the five routes server-renders its heading, table and FAQ; each canonical equals its own URL; the release check fails on regression; the delivery shows the dated before and after for every route.

Measured: visible words in served HTML (today 8 on the comparison routes), canonical-equals-self (today 0 of 3), and after four weeks the number of those URLs indexed under their own address. No ranking claim is made from the rendering change alone.

upvotes.reason: "Make the shared comparison route render server HTML before five pages are written on top of it" addresses the plumbing behind this goal, which is what has to be fixed before anything downstream shows up. it fills a gap the goal has open rather than restating what is already covered.

I re-ran the check on 22 Oct 2026: /compare, /alternatives and /discord-vs-zedu each return HTTP 200 with 8 visible words in the served HTML and a canonical of https://zedu.chat, while /solutions/bootcamps serves 422 words and its own canonical. Pages written on this route would not be readable by a crawler and would point at the home page, so fixing the route first is necessary, not optional.
Fixes a real UX issue with share previews that affects link clicks.
